subject: Nebula Analytics — vendor onboarding, PO window & proposed early-settlement options
messages:
From: Jessica Barnes <jessica@nebula-analytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@nebula-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nebula Analytics - vendor onboarding & initial billing terms

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier — Nebula is excited to get Redwood set up as a preferred inference provider for our analytics pipelines. Attached is our completed onboarding packet (nebula_onboarding_form.docx) and W-9.

A few items we wanted to put on the table up front so Procurement can include them in the PO:
- Our standard AP cadence is Net 60; we can accommodate Net 30 with a short-term credit review.
- We often ask partners for early-settlement discounts; if Redwood can offer 1% off invoice for payment within 20 days, we can prioritize them for faster ramp scheduling.

Can you confirm the PO workflow at Redwood (PO number, who to cc on invoice, and cutoff day for invoice processing each month)? Also, Ben (cc) is our finance lead and will handle the contractual billing details.

Attached: nebula_onboarding_form.docx; vendor_w9.pdf

Thanks,
Jessica Barnes
Head of Vendor Ops | Nebula Analytics
J: 415-555-0123
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Barnes <jessica@nebula-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula Analytics - vendor onboarding & initial billing terms

Hi Jessica — welcome, and thanks for sending the packet. Looping in Laura (Finance) and Priyom (Vendor Ops) to confirm our PO and payment flow. Quick answers below, and a couple of asks so we can finalize the first invoice: 

- PO process: We require a signed vendor onboarding form + W-9, then Procurement issues a PO tied to the account and deal. Please confirm the billing entity/company name exactly as you'd like it on the PO.
- Invoice routing: invoices@redwood.com is our AR mailbox; please cc procurement@redwood.com for the first invoice so it ties to the PO.
- Invoice cutoff: our monthly invoice processing window is the 1st-5th business day — invoices received by the 5th are batched for that month.

On terms: Finance prefers Net 30 for new vendors, but they are open to Net 45/60 if an early-settlement program is included. Laura — can you share what discount bands we can offer (if any) for early payment windows? Priyom — once terms are agreed, can you confirm the PO lead time so Nebula knows when to invoice?

If agreeable, I can share a simple settlement matrix back to you with a couple of options (Net 30 standard; Net 45 with small discount; early-settlement incentive) so Ben can pick what works best.

Thanks — Marcus
Director, Partner Success | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jessica Barnes <jessica@nebula-analytics.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nebula Analytics - vendor onboarding & initial billing terms

Marcus / Jessica,

Thanks for the details. Finance reviewed and here's what we can do for onboarding vendors like Nebula: 

- Baseline: Net 30 (preferred for cashflow alignment).
- Alternate: Net 45 for vendors who require additional time, but Redwood can offer a 0.5% early-payment discount if invoices are paid within 20 days.
- Early-settlement program: For strategic partners we can offer a tiered discount for payment within a shorter window. See attached proposed_settlement_matrix.xlsx with three options: 
  * Option A: Net 30 — standard (no discount)
  * Option B: Net 45 — 0.5% discount if paid within 20 days
  * Option C: Net 60 — 1.0% discount if paid within 15 days (requires finance review and executive sign-off)

Notes: Option C is exceptional and typically reserved for vendor relationships where Nebula provides staging credits or other commercial incentives. If you want Option C, please confirm expected quarterly invoice volume so I can take to the CFO.

Next steps: Marcus — if Nebula picks a preferred option, Priyom will open the PO and supply the PO number. Jessica / Ben — can you confirm the exact legal entity and VAT/Tax ID to ensure the PO matches the invoice?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Jessica Barnes <jessica@nebula-analytics.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@nebula-analytics.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula Analytics - vendor onboarding & initial billing terms

Hi Laura / Marcus — thanks, that matrix is very helpful. A couple quick responses from Nebula: 

- Legal entity for billing: Nebula Analytics, Inc. (EIN: 82-1234567) — please use that exact name on the PO.
- Preferred: We would like to move to Net 30, but we are very interested in an early-settlement option. Nebula can commit to prioritizing Redwood (earlier PO approvals / faster ramp) if Redwood can offer Option B-like pricing.
- Counter-proposal: Nebula is comfortable with Net 45 if Redwood agrees to 1% discount for payments made within 15 days. That would help our cashflow and still align with your Option B/C structure.

I attached a short note with expected first-quarter usage and an estimated invoice amount (~$42k / month) to help Finance evaluate Option C if needed.

On PO timing — Priyom, once we confirm terms, what is a realistic lead time for the first PO to be issued?

Best,
Jessica
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Jessica Barnes <jessica@nebula-analytics.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nebula Analytics - vendor onboarding & initial billing terms

Folks — quick summary and action plan: 

- Nebula requests either Net 30 (preferred by them) or Net 45 with a 1% early-payment discount for payment within 15 days. They estimate ~$42k/month to start.
- Laura: Can Finance confirm if we can provisionally approve 1% @15 days for onboarding or if CFO sign-off is required? Rafael, please flag if this needs exec approval.
- Priyom: If terms are confirmed by EOD Wed, can Procurement issue PO within 2 business days (we'll include Nebula's onboarding packet and W-9)? Also confirm the PO number format to share with the vendor.

I'll hold on issuing any commitments externally until I hear back from Finance. Jessica — thanks for the quick turnaround; we should be able to move fast once Finance confirms the discount band.

- Marcus
Director, Partner Success | Redwood Inference
